about.text: Butter churned from whey cream, the fat skimmed off cheese whey. Whey cream has 25–30% fat, less than ordinary cream. Cheesemakers turn it into butter when they would rather not return it to the cheese milk, for example because of the risk of bacteriophages.

how.text: Churned like any cream, but the whey cream is thinner and saltier, so the butter has its own flavour. No churning temperatures were found in a source I opened.
